While the authors optimized sample preparation parameters (bead volume, incubation time, digestion time), these are technical/instrumental optimizations rather than biological perturbations. The application to 19 human plasma samples was for profiling/characterization of natural variation, not a differential case-control or treatment study. Therefore, it is classified as un-classified.
